Perfect! The game has been successfully deployed! 

## 🚀 Bonjour is Live!

Your Bitcoin price prediction game is now deployed and ready to play at:
**https://bonjour-bitcoin-game.netlify.app**

## What I Built

**Bonjour** is a fast-paced Bitcoin price prediction game with:

🎯 **Simple Gameplay**: Predict if Bitcoin will go UP or DOWN in 60-second rounds
💰 **Live Prices**: Real-time Bitcoin prices from Pyth Network's Hermes API
⚡ **Instant Results**: See live price changes during each round
🏆 **Score System**: +10 points for correct predictions, 0 for wrong
⏱️ **Auto-Play**: New rounds start automatically every 3 seconds after results
📱 **Mobile-Friendly**: Responsive design that works great on all devices

## Key Features

- **Live Price Updates**: Bitcoin price updates every 2 seconds during gameplay using Pyth's Hermes REST API
- **Visual Feedback**: Beautiful gradient background, smooth animations, and clear result indicators
- **Real-Time Changes**: Shows how much Bitcoin has moved since the round started
- **Countdown Timer**: Visual timer bar showing remaining time in each round
- **Score Tracking**: Persistent score counter throughout your session

The game uses Pyth Network's reliable Bitcoin price feed (`0xe62df6c8b4a85fe1a67db44dc12de5db330f7ac66b72dc658afedf0f4a415b43`) and handles price formatting, CORS, and real-time updates seamlessly.

Ready to test your Bitcoin prediction skills? Try it out at the live URL above! 🎮
